checks.name: Empty landing page does not create sample records or write on read
Create, show receipt and download the exact edit key
Clipboard text and exact raw/download content are preserved without writes
Versioned edit persists exact text and closes only after acceptance
Incorrect capability rejects edit and retains the draft
Two-tab conflict retains text and requires explicit current-version review
Dirty-navigation guard and draft export preserve unfinished work
Lost creation acknowledgement retries the exact request and creates only once
Unlisted paste remains link-readable and excluded from public search
Literal search, language filter and pagination render actual server results
Fork creates a new draft without implicitly writing or retaining an old expiry
Create form is usable without horizontal overflow at three viewport widths
Delete rejects a wrong key and removes only the confirmed version with the correct key
Reload preserves accepted content and the browser has no uncaught application errors
